messages:
emma: Heads-up: saw a spike in SCIM deprovision failures right after the infra RBAC prune. Connector returning 403 and KMS logs show AccessDenied on decrypt.

frank: got the alert too. link: https://console.company/alerts/SCIM-DEPROV-403-1788889999

emma: Relevant log excerpt:
```
2026-03-22T14:03:12Z ERROR scim-provisioner idp=gsuite req=xyz123 err="KMS: decrypt failed: AccessDenied" user_extid=acct-4821
2026-03-22T14:03:13Z WARN  scim-provisioner deprov_retry=1 user_extid=acct-4821 idp_resp=403
```

gina: which principal is the connector assuming? I thought scim-syncer used the `scim-sync-role` mapped from k8s SA `scim-syncer` in ns `idp-sync`.

ops-bot: ALERT: KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED principal=arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/scim-sync-role/2026-03-22T14:03:11Z (count=8)

frank: traced it to PR #4890 (infra: prune legacy grants). That PR detached an inline policy that granted kms:Decrypt on alias/scim-mappings from the group `infra-tooling`. The timeline matches: PR merged 14:00 UTC, failures start ~14:03.

emma: so the role hasn't been deleted, just lost the policy that allowed decrypt. That explains the repeated deprovision retries — connector can't read mapping envelope to find internal id.

gina: short mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily reattach a minimal kms:Decrypt statement to `scim-sync-role` with condition restricting by `aws:PrincipalTag/deployment=scim` or `aws:CalledVia` if we can, 2) drain deprov queue, 3) create a scoped follow-up to lock deletion of policies that affect tagged service accounts.

frank: commands I used to validate: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-22T13:50:00Z --end-time 2026-03-22T14:10:00Z
aws iam get-role --role-name scim-sync-role
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/scim-mappings
```
CloudTrail shows Decrypt denied at 14:03:11 and iam:DetachRolePolicy at 14:00:02 for principal `infra-prune-runner`.

ops-bot: CHANGE: temporary-policy-attach by frank @ 2026-03-22T14:07:03Z (web-console)

frank: temporary policy attached at 14:07:03. SCIM logs show `200 OK deprovision user_extid=acct-4821` at 14:07:48 and backlog is draining.

compliance: we need an incident ticket for the emergency policy change and a justification — please include who approved and the audit snapshot.

gina: I'm taking snapshots now and uploading to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-XYZ-scim-deprov-prune. Also recording the PR that caused it.

emma: postmortem items I'm adding: - root cause: RBAC prune removed decrypt access used by SCIM connector - contributing: no CI guardrail preventing removal of policies referenced by tagged infra SAs - remediation: add pre-merge check to flag policy removals affecting roles with tag `service-account=true`, implement IAM guardrail to deny detach/delete on roles matching that tag, add alert for KMS Decrypt spikes.

frank: question about key rotation: do we need to rotate the CMK (alias/scim-mappings) or just rewrap the per-record data keys? I prefer rewrap to avoid wide CMK rotation.

gina: Agreed — schedule a rewrap job that generates new data keys, re-encrypts mapping blobs, and retires old ciphertexts. We'll run during low traffic window.

emma: temporary policy will be auto-revoked in 2 hours via the revoke-lambda. Ticket INC-2026-XYZ opened and assigned to sec-eng for postmortem.

ops-bot: SCHEDULED_TASK: revoke-temporary-policy at 2026-03-22T16:07:03Z

frank: I've reconciled 7 of the 9 half-deprov rows. 2 left for automated job. Query I used: `SELECT extid, status, last_attempt FROM scim_mappings WHERE status != 'deleted' AND last_attempt > '2026-03-22T13:50:00Z'`

gina: thanks. We'll add the CI check and a small policy tagging acceptance test to infra PR template.

emma: closing emergency channel once cloudtrail snapshots and approvals are attached to INC-2026-XYZ. Follow-ups: CI rule, IAM guardrail, mapping rewrap job, postmortem doc. Resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
